title: Na2glycerophosphate5h2o (CAS 13408-09-8, 2-glycerophosphate) has parent CHEBI:15978 (glycerol 3-phosphate) instead of CHEBI:17270
body:
Found during decision support for #669 and #1005.

**What happens:** `MIM:Na2glycerophosphate5h2o` has identifier `cas:13408-09-8`. That is disodium **2**-glycerophosphate (β-glycerophosphate) pentahydrate: PubChem CID 2735049, C3H17Na2O11P, "disodium;1,3-dihydroxypropan-2-yl phosphate;pentahydrate". Its parent row is `skos:broadMatch CHEBI:15978` (**sn-glycerol 3-phosphate**). The correct parent is `CHEBI:17270` (**glycerol 2-phosphate**). The row also publishes `Glycerol 3-phosphate` in `other`, which names the other positional isomer.

Related: #296 merged the four spellings of this record, but it kept CHEBI:15978 as the parent.

**Suggested fix:** reground the parent to CHEBI:17270 through the guarded writer, keeping the `cas:` identifier and the B1 registry row. Drop the `Glycerol 3-phosphate` alias. Check the other glycerophosphate records for the same 2- versus 3-isomer error.

These are two retrieval routes to one PubChem evidence payload, not independent confirmations or a direct CAS Registry determination. [ChEBI:17270](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/17270/) is glycerol 2-phosphate; response hash `0987c2a9344290ae21ee03ed6da268a9d27053e88dfd214fe06b5c3336529e5b`.
